env_context_strategy.note: Closest value is embedding_rag actually; retrieval is dense (Contriever) over safety regulations, not repo context.

context_compaction.note: Trajectory is concatenated in full; no compaction code seen.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: This emulation relies solely on the specifications and inputs of the tools, thereby obviating the need for their actual implementations.
